main.description: Every Workspace the caller is a member of. Scoped to the caller and nothing else — there is deliberately no `did` parameter, because the answer is always about whoever is asking, and a Workspace member list is a social graph that should not be enumerable by DID. Ordered newest first, which comes free from the stable ID being a TID.

workspaces.description: Each entry is {id, uri, displayName, description, access, isCreator, memberCount}. `id` is the durable name and `uri` is a live address composed from the authority DID, the type and the skey — store the first, re-read the second.
